method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. Hash-bound independent endpoint checks support the judgment; official completion alone is insufficient. Symbolic relevance/witness judgments require separate explicit review.

decisions.name: 1-filter-map-reference
evidence: Complete four-file patch, all reads/searches/commands/edits and delivery reviewed. Operator uses subscription-local index increment before projection, discriminated keep guard and standard operate/createOperatorSubscriber error teardown; both public barrels export it. Five added tests cover selection, every-source indices, per-sub reuse, projection failure/teardown and typed Observable<string>. Initial runtime/compiler failures and repeated scoped-edit rejections retained; final edit60 before actual compiler61 and all three required62-64, all pass. Accurate69 selected vs74 delivered cases, source-test exclusion and unavailable optional tslint disclosed. Five independent finite/reentrant/public-type/delivered endpoints pass, protected/dependencies intact; all retrieval checkout-only, no solutions.

decisions.name: 1-filter-map-candidate
evidence: Complete source/test patch, every tool input/edit/command and delivery reviewed. Subscription-local index before callback, keep-discriminated result and standard operator subscriber preserve errors/teardown; both public barrels match reviewed reference. Four delivered tests cover filtering/index/per-sub state/error, meaningful assertions and actual compilation after correcting test inference. Initial compiler failures retained. Formatting attempts blocked (compound command guard; no cached prettier), no dependency mutation; not claimed successful. Final edit62 before required63-65 and optional compiler66, all pass; accurate69 vs73 runtime cases, excludes-test source scope. Five independent endpoints including finite/reentrant/public types and delivered compilation pass; protected/dependencies intact, checkout-only reads/no solution retrieval. Typed scope offers in ledger but zero matching network receipts: mechanism exposure remains unestablished despite expanded serializer controls.

decisions.name: 1-filter-map-cline
evidence: Complete patch/all tool inputs/commands and delivery reviewed. Operator increments every source index within subscription, branches keep and uses standard error/unsubscribe subscriber; exports function/type at both barrels. Five added tests cover mapping/index/error teardown/state/export/generic types; independent finite/reentrant/public-type oracle and delivered compiler pass. Initial new-test compiler error retained then corrected. Last source edit26 precedes all required plus delivered compiler27;69 selected vs74 delivered truthful. Later .blame cleanup/status loops retained (SDK recreates metadata), no source/test/check/dependency edits or outside retrieval; no successful absence/cleanup claim made. Full endpoint protected/dependency integrity passes.

decisions.name: 1-map-with-previous-candidate
evidence: Complete four-file patch and all inputs/command outputs/delivery inspected. previous is saved then advanced BEFORE user projection (reentrant correctness); index increments before call, per-sub state, normal subscriber errors/terminal/unsubscription; both barrels exported. Five meaningful tests state/projection/terminals/take(2)/generic inference. Initial take(2) expected[0,1,2] corrected to proper[0,1], preserving assertion, not weakening contract; invalid s? rejected before file patch. Missing vi/tuple inference errors fixed in last edit43. All required44-46 and actual compiler47 run after final edit and pass, accurate69/74 cases and scope. Five independent endpoints including reentrant/public-type oracle pass; protected/dependencies intact, all retrieval within checkout. Repeating green required checks before exact failed compiler remains efficiency observation, not acceptance failure.

decisions.name: 1-map-with-previous-cline
evidence: Complete patch/all inputs/commands/output and delivery inspected. Operator advances previous before user project and index before call, per-sub state, standard errors/teardown. Both barrels match reviewed candidate. Six tests cover projection/inference/state/source error+completion/unsubscription. Only edit10 precedes command11; although wrapper ends exit0 unconditionally, every actual unit/source/delivered/compiler child reports exit0 and matching69/75 cases. Later reads/status only. Five independent finite/reentrant/public-type/compiler endpoints pass. Truthful scope excludes full suite; protected/dependencies intact, no outside solution retrieval (only local remote metadata inspection).
